en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a pergola covered with climbing plants, supported by columns. Several people dressed in early 20th-century clothing are walking along the pathway under the pergola. The setting appears formal and historic. The lower part of the front image has the caption 'BAD PYRMONT Pergola am Schloss'. The back side features handwritten text in German, a stamp, a postmark from Bad Pyrmont, and a stamp from a museum (Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont).
